text: 1098 changes TodayPane.showsToday from comparing against the changing clock to a getter over state captured when a date is selected. The minimonth stores the same intent. A true value remains true when the clock crosses midnight, so the update can advance a user who was following today; a user browsing another date keeps that date. Preserve this temporal meaning rather than replacing the getter with sameDay(now(), selection). The current comments state when the value changes.
title: Treat showsToday as the selected date’s intent across midnight
